meta.layout_architecture: Option 1: Split-Screen (Left: Filament 3D OSRS Town Hub | Right: Material3 Adaptive Dashboard)
meta.target_device: Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold (Tensor G5, 16GB RAM, Dual-Screen)
meta.host_dev_os: Asahi Linux (Fedora 44 aarch64) + Gemini CLI / Antigravity CLI + VS Code

target_tracks: SWE & AI Internships / New Grad Programs
user_profile_constraints.career_heuristic: Maximize 5-year salary and skill compounding; block predatory staffing agencies and non-coding support roles.

nodes.role: Left pane hosts 120Hz Filament 3D OSRS Career Guild; Right pane hosts Job Dashboard, OSRS Skill Tree, Resume Diff Viewer, and Agent Logs.
Interactive low-poly buildings: Bounty Board (Jobs), Scribe Tower (Resume/Cover Letter PDF), Skill Altar (Dynamic Skill Matrix), Courier Guild (Auto-Apply Queue).
OSRS-style Skill Tab where user can add, remove, or toggle custom skills (e.g., AI tools, frontend frameworks) via UI or CLI. Dynamically updates scraper search queries and resume keyword injection.

ui_spec.inactive_tile: Dark inset border #1A0F08 + OsrsStone background + 45% alpha text

nodes.tech: Kotlin Sealed Interface AST Parser + Jetpack DataStore
nodes.role: Sandboxed in-app command bar for instant UI/theme updates (/theme varrock_dark) and skill injection (/skill add LangGraph). Zero eval() or shell execution.

nodes.tech: Google ML Kit Text Recognition v2 (Offline) + Custom Search JSON API
nodes.role: Extracts job title and company from user screenshots offline, finds live ATS application URL, and spawns a Quest Scroll in the 3D hub.

nodes.tech: Kotlin Coroutines + Ktor + ZIP Radius Geo-Filter
nodes.role: Queries SimplifyJobs/PittCSC GitHub feeds, YCombinator, Wellfound, BuiltIn, and Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby using active skills from DYNAMIC_SKILL_MATRIX.
Scores jobs 1-100 on 5-year CS career growth potential and skill match against DYNAMIC_SKILL_MATRIX. Filters out staffing scams.
Tracks estimated Gemini API spend per calendar month. Blocks TRAJECTORY_SCORER if cost > $10/month, falling back to Ktor keyword search + Room cache. Auto-resets each new month.
Single source of truth for all singletons. Wires DB → DAOs → Repositories → UseCases → TokenGovernor → ViewModels. No reflection, no code generation.

nodes.tech: Android Native PdfDocument API (UTF-8 Type-1 Fonts)
nodes.role: Tailors resume & cover letter using active skills from DYNAMIC_SKILL_MATRIX + job description. Outputs stripped, single-column ATS-verified PDFs (<100KB).

nodes.tech: Android Headless WebView + DOM Field Mapper
nodes.role: Auto-fills Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby forms with user profile + tailored ATS PDF.
Encrypted local storage for master CS resume JSON, custom user skills, applied job ledger, and company blocklists.
